dataset.source: AWS public Bitcoin Parquet, construction queries included
dataset.missing: A chain-tip block hash and immutable raw provider snapshot ID were not recovered.

strata.output_age_semantics: Intervals are intersected with eligible segments. Event endpoint and week tests follow the supplied SQL, including the shared upper endpoint convention.
strata.address_age_band: all, after aggregation of eligible segments
strata.address_meta: minimum era and any_value(fam) over per-population address segments, exactly as person_time_addr.py
strata.week: Monday UTC. Risk boundary deltas apply in the following week. Event requires opening week strictly before spend week.
strata.exposure: P2PK/P2TR at creation, otherwise address-history revelation. Screened variants truncate at recognised cross-format revelations.
strata.partial_address_spend: Marks the whole exposed dormant address value as moved.

fitting.normalisation: theta <- theta / mean(theta) after each alternating update
fitting.theta_update: sum events / sum hazard*risk, NaN filled by 1
fitting.regime_prior: raw control event/prediction ratio, pandas EWM span=8, adjust=True, min_periods=1, shifted one week and initial fill=1

bootstrap.block_start: rng.integers(0,len(training_z)-8), high exclusive, as actual implementation
bootstrap.CUSUM: 40 bisection steps for threshold, alarms reset state, mean alarm frequency target 1/104
bootstrap.ARL_scope: Nominal training calibration by alarm frequency, not a proof of fitted future first-run length

ARGUS_e.drift: training 90th percentile of absolute deviation of 13-week exposed/control count ratio from one
ARGUS_e.scope: No bootstrap calibration. Conditional theorem requires true admissible rates and uniform drift, not just predictable fitting.

replay.weekly_pace: m times reference weekly sigma, carried forward in absolute BTC
replay.cancellation: Natural events of a stolen address from theft week onward removed
replay.risk_update: Risk removal from following week, value and second moments recomputed
replay.refits: Original global 13-week calendar, contaminated 104-week lookback with 13-week gap
replay.first_alarm: Include theft in alarm week, or all 52 weeks if silent
replay.curve_inequality: eprocess, ctm, threshold use >=; all other saved scores use >
replay.precision: Nominal outcomes saved double, weekly score/theft arrays float32, independently reconciled curve loss discrepancy <=0.379273 BTC

status: Local reproducibility bundle, not a publicly archived DOI release or confirmation of novelty.
